{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column for non-null values first
revenue_non_null = sales['revenue'].dropna()

# Check for commas only in non-null values
has_commas = revenue_non_null.str.contains(',', na=False)

# Print the unique values that have commas
print("Unique revenue values with commas:", revenue_non_null[has_commas].unique())

# Now safely clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded_orders))"}
